meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会帮你检查或设置 claude-mem 到 cmem.ai 的云同步:把 cmem.ai Connect 提供的同步 token、user id、SyncHub URL 写入设置文件,重启 worker 并核实连接状态。它不会打印同步 token,只确认其长度。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」等关键词,或想查看同步状态、把记忆库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看云同步现在是什么状态
我要设置云同步,三个连接值在 cmem.ai → Connect
say.note: 写入设置文件后重启 worker 并验证

say.text: 把记忆库同步到我的 cmem.ai 账户

howto.what_en: Claude checks or sets up claude-mem cloud sync to cmem.ai: writes the token, user id, and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai Connect into settings, restarts the worker, and verifies the connection. It never prints the token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro" and similar, or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account, or check sync status.

say_en.note: Queries the worker sync status route

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync - my three values are on cmem.ai Connect
Sync my memory database to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Needs cmem.ai Pro token, user id, and Hub URL
